rev2.hero.lede: What patients say about us on Google and Facebook.
rev2.ch.title: Google & Facebook — direct links
rev2.g.d: Read patients' ratings and feedback on the clinic's Google Maps listing.
rev2.g.note: The Google listing may still show the former name 'Baridhara Piles Cure Center' — it is the same clinic.
rev2.f.d: See patient feedback and the clinic's education posts on the official Facebook page.
rev2.how.title: How to write a Google review
rev2.how.s1: Open Google Maps — in the app or a browser.
rev2.how.s2: Search for 'Dhaka Piles Care Center' or 'Baridhara Piles Cure Center'.
rev2.how.s3: Open the clinic's listing and scroll to the reviews section.
rev2.how.s4: Tap 'Write a review' and describe your experience.
rev2.how.fb: A recommendation on the Facebook page also helps a lot — write it in your own words, in your own language.
rev2.cta.t: Get in touch today — tell us about your problem
rev2.cta.d: Before or after reading the reviews — one call is enough for a first consultation. Fix a time.
rev2.embed.d: Ratings and reviews from Google Maps. The listing may show the former name, Baridhara Piles Cure Center — it is the same clinic.
